About us
Verve for Advertisers (VFA) combines two parts of Verve Group:
Captify , the search intelligence business based in Europe.
Jun Group , a US company for mobile and video advertising, with opt-in survey audiences.
We join large-scale search intent data with first-party survey and engagement data to build audience and targeting products for advertisers. The ML team works across Europe and the US.
The role
You'll build and run the ML systems behind our audience products, from embedding-based lookalike models and multi-language intent classifiers to low-latency prediction APIs and campaign performance optimisation. This is a hands-on engineering role: you'll take models from experiment to production, then keep them fast, reliable and cost-efficient at scale.
What you'll do
Build and improve audience models: embeddings, lookalike and similarity scoring, and intent and content classification (NLP, transformers, LLMs)
Apply recent architectures from ML research to redesign how user and campaign features are modelled
Work closely with traders on live campaigns: investigate performance and delivery issues, turn the findings into tools and models that improve results
Ship real-time inference services (Ray Serve, FastAPI) to tight latency targets, including traffic-quality models such as invalid traffic (IVT) detection.
Build batch on Spark/Databricks/BigQuery
Manage the model lifecycle with MLflow: experiment tracking, the model registry, and versioned deployments
Containerise and deploy services on Kubernetes
Run vector search at scale (Postgres with pgvector) and deliver audience exports to activation partners.
Run experiments end to end: offline evaluation (lift, holdouts), A/B tests, and turning results into product decisions.
Work closely with product and data engineering in Europe and the US.
What you'll need
ML engineering experience including models you've shipped and run in production
Strong Python and SQL
Hands-on with PyTorch and scikit-learn and gradient-boosted models
Large-scale data processing with PySpark
MLOps and model serving: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, MLflow
Experience with AWS and/or GCP
Strong ML fundamentals: evaluation, feature engineering, leakage and bias
Clear communication
Nice to have
AdTech experience: audiences, identity resolution, programmatic (DSPs and SSPs)
Vector databases and ANN indexes, semantic search, and LLM fine-tuning
Ray, Databricks and Terraform.
Streaming with Kafka or Flink.
GPU inference optimisation: quantisation, batching, model compression.
Load testing and observability
Privacy-aware ML (GDPR, CCPA, classifying sensitive categories).
